@@ -281,17 +284,119 @@ mod SelfhostChecker do
 
   def debottom(t String) String := if t == "bottom" do "unknown" else t end
 
-  # the join kernel: bottom is the identity, equal types join to themselves, anything
-  # with `unknown` is `unknown`, and a non-equal pair is conservatively `unknown`
-  # (cross-width numeric widening not yet ported).
+  # the join kernel (ADR-0059): bottom is the identity, equal types join to
+  # themselves, anything with `unknown` is `unknown`, and two distinct NUMERIC types
+  # climb to their least-upper-bound width/kind (Rian.Check.join). A non-numeric
+  # non-equal pair is `unknown` (parametric covariant join — `Vec(A)`⊔`Vec(B)` — is
+  # the remaining tail).
   def join(a String, b String) String
   def join("bottom", b) := b
   def join(a, "bottom") := a
   def join(a, b)
     if a == b do
       a
     else
-      "unknown"
+      join_num(a, b)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def join_num(a String, b String) String
+  def join_num(a, b)
+    case num_kind(a) do
+      NkNone -> "unknown"
+      Nk(ka, wa) -> join_num2(ka, wa, b)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def join_num2(ka String, wa Int53, b String) String
+  def join_num2(ka, wa, b)
+    case num_kind(b) do
+      NkNone -> "unknown"
+      Nk(kb, wb) -> num_join(ka, wa, kb, wb)
+    end
+  end
+
+  # same kind -> widest width; else the cross-kind rules (uint⊔int, int⊔float, …).
+  def num_join(ka String, wa Int53, kb String, wb Int53) String
+  def num_join(ka, wa, kb, wb)
+    if ka == kb do
+      kind_prefix(ka) <> Prim.int_to_string(max2(wa, wb))
+    else
+      num_join_mixed(ka, wa, kb, wb)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def num_join_mixed(ka String, wa Int53, kb String, wb Int53) String
+  def num_join_mixed("uint", wa, "int", wb) := uint_signed_join(wa, wb)
+  def num_join_mixed("int", wa, "uint", wb) := uint_signed_join(wb, wa)
+  def num_join_mixed("int", wa, "float", wb) := int_float_join(wa - 1, wb)
+  def num_join_mixed("float", wa, "int", wb) := int_float_join(wb - 1, wa)
+  def num_join_mixed("uint", wa, "float", wb) := int_float_join(wa, wb)
+  def num_join_mixed("float", wa, "uint", wb) := int_float_join(wb, wa)
+  def num_join_mixed(_, _, _, _) := "unknown"
+
+  # `UIntᵤ ⊔ Intᵢ` = least Int width strictly wider than `u` (to hold the unsigned
+  # range) and at least `i`; none ⇒ `unknown`.
+  def uint_signed_join(u Int53, i Int53) String := find_int_width([8, 16, 32, 64, 128], u, i)
+
+  def find_int_width(Vec(Int53), Int53, Int53) String
+  def find_int_width([], _, _) := "unknown"
+  def find_int_width([c | rest], u, i)
+    if c > u and c >= i do
+      "Int" <> Prim.int_to_string(c)
+    else
+      find_int_width(rest, u, i)
+    end
+  end
+
+  # Int/UInt ⊔ Float = least Float width ≥ the float operand whose mantissa holds the
+  # integer's `exact` bits; none ⇒ `unknown`.
+  def int_float_join(exact Int53, fb Int53) String := find_float_width([32, 64], exact, fb)
+
+  def find_float_width(Vec(Int53), Int53, Int53) String
+  def find_float_width([], _, _) := "unknown"
+  def find_float_width([c | rest], exact, fb)
+    if c >= fb and float_mantissa(c) >= exact do
+      "Float" <> Prim.int_to_string(c)
+    else
+      find_float_width(rest, exact, fb)
+    end
+  end
+
+  def float_mantissa(Int53) Int53
+  def float_mantissa(64) := 53
+  def float_mantissa(32) := 24
+  def float_mantissa(_) := 0
+
+  def kind_prefix(k String) String
+  def kind_prefix("int") := "Int"
+  def kind_prefix("uint") := "UInt"
+  def kind_prefix("float") := "Float"
+  def kind_prefix(_) := ""
+
+  def max2(a Int53, b Int53) Int53 := if a >= b do a else b end
+
+  # decompose `UInt`/`Int`/`Float` + a non-empty all-digit width; else NkNone (so a
+  # bare `Int` (arbitrary precision) / `Bool` / `Char` is not numeric here).
+  def num_kind(t String) NumKind := nk(Prim.str_chars(t))
+
+  def nk(Vec(Int53)) NumKind
+  def nk(['U', 'I', 'n', 't' | rest]) := nk_width("uint", rest)
+  def nk(['I', 'n', 't' | rest]) := nk_width("int", rest)
+  def nk(['F', 'l', 'o', 'a', 't' | rest]) := nk_width("float", rest)
+  def nk(_) := NkNone
+
+  def nk_width(kind String, w Vec(Int53)) NumKind
+  def nk_width(_, []) := NkNone
+  def nk_width(kind, w)
+    if all_digits(w) do
+      Nk(kind, parse_digits(w, 0))
+    else
+      NkNone
     end
   end
+
+  def parse_digits(Vec(Int53), Int53) Int53
+  def parse_digits([], acc) := acc
+  def parse_digits([c | rest], acc) := parse_digits(rest, acc * 10 + c - 48)
 end
